[[Overseer]] |TV actor =[[Nina Kassa]] }} '''Sarah Clements''' is an employee of the [[Vault-Tec Corporation]] {{In|FOTV}}. ==Background== Sarah Clements was a Vault-Tec employee who worked in and around [[Hollywood]]. She and [[George Yaffe]] received [[the Ghoul|Cooper Howard]], a famous actor, at a Hollywood studio when he was convinced to film an advertisement for Vault-Tec on the urging of his wife [[Barb Howard|Barb]], one of the company's executives. Cooper told them that he had never filmed any ads before this one, which George and Sarah laughed off. Later, after Cooper put on a [[Vault jumpsuit]] for the ad, he asked them if it was protective against radiation. Barb gave George and Sarah a side-eye, and they hesitated before Sarah claimed that the jumpsuit did, in fact, do so. They proceeded to watch Cooper pose for the ad.{{FOTV|1|3}} ==''Fallout'' TV series== ===[[The Head]]=== Sarah is seen talking with her colleague George as Barb talks to her husband about how dapper dressed he is and if he's ready to meet the "suits". When Cooper walks toward them, he shakes both of their hands, and Sarah cordially thanks Cooper on behalf of the whole Vault-Tec family, mentioning how delighted they are that Barb used her connections to get him. Cooper admits that he's never done an advertisement in his entire life, but jokingly said that Barb never asked him to. After they share a laugh, Sarah leads Cooper to the photo-op spot. There, Cooper comments on how tight the suit is and asks if it really does block [[radiation]]. Barb signals for George and Sarah to answer, and after a slight hesitation, she claims that it absolutely does. Cooper then thanks the crew for all of their hard work to benefit America, which earns him a modest round of applause. After this, Cooper's photoshoot starts. He is unhappy with most of them and decides to do one with a thumbs up. George approves of it, calling him Coop, which irks Sarah. ==Appearances== Sarah Clements appears only {{in|FOTV}}. {{FOTV appearances|3=103}} ==Gallery== FOTV s1 ep3 George and Sarah.png|George and Sarah greet Cooper Howard FOTV s1 ep3 George and Sarah 2.png|George and Sarah lie about the Vault jumpsuits ==References== {{References}} {{Navbox characters FOTV}} {{Navbox overseers}} [[Category:Fallout TV series human characters]] [[Category:Vault-Tec characters]]
